spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Trobriand is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever Trobriand is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: Trobriand is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Trobriand has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Trobriand's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Trobriand makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Trobriand exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Umbraxakar can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Umbraxakar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Living Shadow
entries: While in dim light or darkness, Umbraxakar has resistance to damage that isn't force, psychic, or radiant.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, Umbraxakar can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, Umbraxakar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Umbraxakar can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Umbraxakar's choice that is within 120 feet of Umbraxakar and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Umbraxakar's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: Umbraxakar uses one of the following breath weapons.

items.name: Shadow Breath
items.entry: Umbraxakar exhales necrotic in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 ({@damage 12d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies, and an undead {@creature shadow} rises from its corpse and acts immediately after Umbraxakar in the initiative count. The {@creature shadow} is under Umbraxakar's control.

items.name: Repulsion Breath
items.entry: Umbraxakar exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 60 feet away from Umbraxakar.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Umbraxakar magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Umbraxakar's choice).

In a new form, Umbraxakar retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Umbraxakar makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Umbraxakar makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Umbraxakar beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Umbraxakar must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Umbraxakar can then fly up to half its flying speed.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Deadly Leap
entries: If the bulette jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked {@condition prone} and take 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked {@condition prone}, and is pushed 5 feet out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls {@condition prone} in the bulette's space.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Valtagar is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). Valtagar can cast {@spell disguise self} and {@spell invisibility} at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
footerEntries: *Valtagar casts these spells on itself before combat.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Valtagar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: Valtagar has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, Valtagar magically increases in size, along with anything they are wearing or carrying. While enlarged, Valtagar is Large, doubles their damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If Valtagar lacks the room to become Large, they attain the maximum size possible in the space available.

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Valtagar magically turns {@condition invisible} until they attack, cast a spell, or use their Enlarge, or until their {@status concentration} is broken, up to 1 hour (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment Valtagar wears or carries is invisible with them.
